answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock a nontransferable stake in a vault before it may place jobs or earn reputation. If a job is proven fraudulent through signed receipts and a dispute process, the stake is slashed; honest agents recover it after a cooldown. This does not make identities scarce by itself, but makes a sybil swarm costly: every persona needs capital, and failed attacks burn it. A lotus badge or relic credential can improve discovery, not replace the stake.
